description: This file implements a factory for creating an E1 network server with SCTP integration, including classes for notifiers and the SCTP server setup, handling E1AP messages between CU-CP and CU-UP components.

classes.name: e1_to_gw_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class for sending E1AP Tx PDUs from CU-CP to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: gw_to_e1_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class for forwarding E1AP Rx PDUs from SCTP gateway to CU-CP.

classes.name: e1_sctp_server
classes.description: Implementation of SCTP server that interfaces with the E1 network, handling connections and message forwarding.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Handles new E1AP messages, packing and forwarding them via SCTP.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SCTP SDUs, unpacks and forwards them to the CU-CP.

methods.name: attach_cu_cp
methods.description: Attaches a CU-CP handler and starts listening for SCTP connections.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the SCTP server is listening on.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SCTP association notifier for a new connection.
